summary: An employer’s offer arrives in response to an application the player remembers submitting.
realLife: Arthur Rynearson recalled applying to the House and Senate legislative counsel offices and interviewing with both. The Senate offer arrived by mail while a separate application at the Library of Congress was still pending.
inGame: The job-offer scene handles the offer; an application-linked version requires the matching application.

turns.what: The employer calls to invite the applicant for another interview.
turns.pulledBy: The application passed its first review and the hiring decision is open.
turns.writesBack: The application advances to an interview with no offer recorded.

turns.what: The offer comes after the applicant has accepted work somewhere else.
turns.pulledBy: Both employers have dated correspondence on file and the applicant has a confirmed start date.
turns.writesBack: The applicant declines the later offer and the first job remains on the employment record.
